B0D5BGST5N.title: Google Nest Learning Thermostat (4th gen) + Nest Temperature Sensor (2nd gen) - Silver
bullets: Nest’s smartest, most advanced thermostat yet, the Google Nest Learning Thermostat (4th gen) is a beautiful, brilliant way to save energy, keep your home comfortable, and help make sure your heating and cooling systems are running smoothly[4]
Savings you can count on: The Nest Learning Thermostat can help save up to 31% on heating and cooling bills [2]

Improved compatibility: It works with most 24V systems, including gas, electric, oil, forced air, heat pump, and radiant, and no C wire is required for installation in most homes; visit the Nest Compatibility Checker for more info[5]

Easy control in the Google Home app: Adjust on your phone from anywhere[1] or by using your voice with Alexa, Siri, or Google Assistant smart speaker[3], it’s easy to install yourself and it’s Matter compatible for simple integration into your smart home[5]

Beautiful design: With a 60% larger display[11] and Dynamic Farsight, you can see info from across the room[1]; choose the design, like a clock or the weather; it automatically adjusts brightness for the best readability or you can adjust manually

Better visibility into adjustments: Asks for permission to make schedule changes to help you save energy; you'll receive notifications in the Google Home app, and you can view and accept changes with a tap[1]

Manage hot and cold spots: It comes with the Nest Temperature Sensor (2nd gen) and works with any Nest Temperature Sensor; put a sensor in any room and use the Google Home app to set the temp it should reach at a certain time of day

New natural heating and cooling: Your thermostat learns how the temperature outside affects the temperature inside (for example, when the sun coming through the windows will heat the house naturally) and pauses your system to help you save[1]
New Adaptive Eco: It uses the temperature outside to help find an energy-saving temperature when you’re away and returns to a comfortable temperature within an hour of your return[1]

B0G25F5XC1.title: Aqara Smart Thermostat W200 with Apple Adaptive Temperature
bullets: Apple Adaptive Temperature - With the Apple Home app, Adaptive Temperature uses your iPhone to adjust the thermostat based on activity states like 'home', 'sleep', 'away' and 'extended away'. This provides comfort upon arrival home and saves energy when away, without the complicated steps of creating or managing schedules. (Note: Adaptive Temperature requires a home hub (Apple TV or HomePod) and an iPhone or Apple Watch, all running version 26 or later.)

Apple Clean Energy Guidance: Smarter Energy Savings - With the Apple Home app, Clean Energy Guidance makes small temperature adjustments to use cleaner grid times when electricity may cost less, while maintaining comfort. The forecast is personalized for your home location using environmental and grid data. (Note: Clean Energy Guidance is available only in the contiguous U.S.)

Easy Installation with Wide HVAC Compatibility - Designed to fit most homes, W200 works with about 85% of HVAC systems, including furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, boilers, and PTAC units. No C-wire? Simply add the Aqara C-Wire Adapter (sold separately) for stable power. We even include a trim kit to easily cover old wiring and keep your wall looking clean and fresh.

Functions as a Smart Display for Your Front Door - W200 works as a visual control panel for your Aqara video doorbell (only compatible with G410/G400, G4 excluded) and smart lock, showing visitor snapshots right on the screen and letting you unlock the door with a simple tap. No need to open an app on your phone or run to the door.

Control Your Climate Your Way: App, Voice Assistant, or One-Tap Button Control – You can manually adjust the temperature via the app, or through voice assistants like Alexa or Siri when connected. You can also use the W100 wireless sensor (sold separately) for quick one-tap physical control. Perfect for easy changes from the couch, bed, or anywhere in your home.

Secure, Local Control Across Major Smart Home Platforms - With Matter 1.4, W200 connects directly to Apple Home, Google Home, Amazon Alexa, and Samsung SmartThings for easy setup and broad compatibility. Unlike cloud-based integrations, Matter runs locally, delivering faster responses, stronger security, and long-term reliability, so your thermostat keeps working even if services or platforms change.

Smarter Presence Detection with Built-In mmWave Radar - W200 uses advanced mmWave radar to detect real human presence, not just motion. It can adjust temperature automatically when you arrive and save energy when no one’s home. As you approach, the screen activates instantly, and the presence sensor can also be used in smart automations, like turning on lights when you walk by. More accurate detection means smarter comfort, easier control, and a home that responds naturally to you.

Smarter, and Better Looking Too - Featuring a large 4-inch full-color touchscreen with smooth curved glass and waterfall corners, W200 brings a clean, modern look to any space. The bright, easy-to-read display makes everyday control simple and intuitive, while the elegant design blends naturally into your home, proving that a smart thermostat can look as good as it performs.

Built-In Smart Home Hub: Connect More, Control Smarter - W200 goes far beyond a thermostat with a built-in Zigbee hub, Matter controller, and Thread border router, bringing your smart home devices together in one place. It bridges Aqara Zigbee devices to major platforms like Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings, and Home Assistant, while extending your Thread network for more reliable coverage. With dual-band Wi-Fi (2.4 / 5GHz) for stable connections, you get a smoother, more unified smart home experience.
